description: This Java source file contains utility methods for mocking and creating instances of MappingContext objects used in testing the connectivity mapping component of the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: MappingContexts
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create mocked instances of MappingContext for testing purposes.

methods.name: mock (String engine, Map<String, String> options)
methods.description: Creates a mock MappingContext with the specified engine and options.

methods.name: mock (Class<? extends MessageMapper> messageMapperClass, Map<String, String> opts)
methods.description: Creates a mock MappingContext based on the class of the message mapper and options.

methods.name: mock (boolean isValid)
methods.description: Creates a mock MappingContext with validity status, using a MockMapper class.
